system.description:
Touch; one living creature (willing or unconscious); casting takes 8 hours and needs a flesh sample from the creature.

  • A duplicate body grows over 2d4 months, then lies dormant and mindless for 1 year per level before it rots.
  • If the original dies while a finished clone exists, its soul enters the clone at once (any distance, same plane): full HP, 2 levels of Exhaustion, no Constitution loss.
  • A creature can have only one clone.
  • If the soul is trapped or unwilling, the clone stays empty.
  • Material: a sealed vat and reagents worth 5,000 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Necromancer, Witch
